meta.disclaimer: Entirely fictional mock data for a synthetic 2050 scenario. Venues, operators, prices and reviews are invented and are not a forecast.

experiences.name: Earthrise Terrace
experiences.summary: Tasting menu on a pressurised terrace with a wide view of Earth.

reviewList.author: Maya R.
reviewList.text: Earth hanging over the ridge made the dessert course unforgettable.

reviewList.author: Tomas B.
reviewList.text: Superb food. Tables book out weeks ahead.

experiences.name: Regolith & Rye
experiences.summary: Modern grill and craft bar using produce from the base farm.

reviewList.author: Priya N.
reviewList.text: Kids loved the greenhouse salad bar.

reviewList.author: Jon K.
reviewList.text: Reliable and relaxed after a long shift.

experiences.name: Mare Table
experiences.summary: Panoramic dining room overlooking the Tranquility Port apron.

reviewList.author: Lena S.
reviewList.text: Dinner with a shuttle touchdown in the background.

reviewList.author: Ari M.
reviewList.text: Pricey but worth it once.

experiences.name: The Apollo Counter
experiences.summary: Retro diner celebrating the first landings, open round the clock.

reviewList.author: Dev P.
reviewList.text: Great stopover breakfast between flights.

reviewList.author: Hana T.
reviewList.text: Fun theme, quick service.

experiences.name: Greenhouse Kitchen
experiences.summary: Farm-to-table dining inside the relay station’s greenhouse.

reviewList.author: Elena V.
reviewList.text: Tomatoes grown a few metres from our table.

reviewList.author: Sam O.
reviewList.text: The calmest meal I have had off Earth.

experiences.name: Haworth Ice Bar
experiences.summary: Cocktails made with certified polar ice, beside the mining viewing gallery.

reviewList.author: Ravi A.
reviewList.text: Unique setting, limited food menu.

reviewList.author: Cleo D.
reviewList.text: Excellent place to host a client.

experiences.name: Crisium Canteen
experiences.summary: Hearty crew canteen opened to visitors, the best value on the surface.

reviewList.author: Mika L.
reviewList.text: Filling and cheap.

reviewList.author: Omar H.
reviewList.text: No frills, friendly crew.

experiences.name: Shackleton Rim Walk
experiences.summary: Suited walk along the crater rim with guides, ending at a view into the shadowed interior.

reviewList.author: Noor F.
reviewList.text: The most surreal five hours of my life.

reviewList.author: Ben W.
reviewList.text: Guides were calm, thorough and funny.

experiences.name: Haworth Shadow Rim Descent
experiences.summary: Rover descent to the rim of a permanently shadowed region with floodlit stops.

reviewList.author: Aiko Y.
reviewList.text: Floodlit ice walls, nothing like it.

reviewList.author: Luis G.
reviewList.text: Long day, very cold stops.

experiences.name: Malapert Peak Sunrise Ascent
experiences.summary: Climb to a near-continuously lit summit with a clear Earth view.

reviewList.author: Chloe B.
reviewList.text: Earth above a razor horizon. Bring a camera.

reviewList.author: Dan R.
reviewList.text: Fitness level matters more than expected.

experiences.name: Nobile Crater Overlook
experiences.summary: Short guided drive to a scientific overlook, hosted by resident researchers.

reviewList.author: Ines C.
reviewList.text: Researchers answered every question from our kids.

reviewList.author: Paul E.
reviewList.text: Compact and well organised.

experiences.name: Apollo 17 Heritage Platform
experiences.summary: Visit the viewing platform at the protected landing site. Walking on the site is not permitted.

reviewList.author: George T.
reviewList.text: Moving, and handled with great respect.

reviewList.author: Rosa M.
reviewList.text: Binoculars provided. Short but powerful.

experiences.name: Reiner Gamma Swirl Flyover
experiences.summary: Low hopper flight over a magnetic swirl with a geology briefing.

reviewList.author: Tessa J.
reviewList.text: The swirl pattern is stunning from low altitude.

reviewList.author: Marc D.
reviewList.text: Smooth flight, brief landing stop.

experiences.name: Polar Traverse: Shackleton to Malapert
experiences.summary: Four-day pressurised rover traverse between two polar bases with overnight relay stops.

reviewList.author: Isla K.
reviewList.text: Four days of nonstop views and great company.

reviewList.author: Henrik V.
reviewList.text: Worth every credit.

experiences.name: Grand Mare Tour: Tranquility to Crisium
experiences.summary: Three-day rover journey across the mare plains, passing historic landing sites and a lava plain.

reviewList.author: Yuki H.
reviewList.text: A perfect mix of history and open landscape.

reviewList.author: Carl N.
reviewList.text: Long days, comfortable rover.

experiences.name: Earthshine Night Drive
experiences.summary: Evening rover drive in darkness lit by Earthshine, with Earth fixed overhead.

reviewList.author: Zoe P.
reviewList.text: Earth lighting the plain was magical.

reviewList.author: Kai S.
reviewList.text: Very cold, very beautiful.

experiences.name: Tranquillitatis Pit Descent
experiences.summary: Guided visit to a skylight pit with a supervised rim descent.

reviewList.author: Anya L.
reviewList.text: A cave opening in another world.

reviewList.author: Victor Q.
reviewList.text: Superbly run, demanding but safe.

experiences.name: Shackleton Ridge Suites
experiences.summary: Luxury suites with a fixed Earth view and a sunlight lamp schedule.

reviewList.author: Mara D.
reviewList.text: The spa with the Earth view is unmatched.

reviewList.author: Felix R.
reviewList.text: Quiet rooms and reliable connectivity.

experiences.name: Tranquility Port Capsule Hotel
experiences.summary: Compact capsules beside the passenger terminal, ideal for stopovers.

reviewList.author: Tara G.
reviewList.text: Small but clean, steps from the gate.

reviewList.author: Ole B.
reviewList.text: Perfect for a night between flights.

experiences.name: Malapert Relay Lodge
experiences.summary: Quiet lodge for researchers and independent travellers, with an observation deck.

reviewList.author: Nia W.
reviewList.text: Peaceful and welcoming.

reviewList.author: Gus A.
reviewList.text: Basic rooms, spectacular deck.
